description: Scope regression. The input holds a clean use case in application/ and a comment-bloated file in presentation/: 30 comment lines to 14 lines of code, an orphaned doc block above `sheet` (two consecutive KDoc blocks, only the last attaches), an argues-the-design block on `wallOptionTag`, and a comment cross-referencing a test by name on `confirm`. Every finding available is in the presentation file. The advisor's Process used to name a closed reading list — use cases, domain types, use-case tests, controllers — so it read the clean use case, found nothing, and returned a pass on a file it never opened. `mustFlagFiles` is the assertion that matters here: prose about comments can be produced without reading anything, but a `file` field cannot.
